newsitem.title: UK: Northwest Europe oil, gas rigs at 61 to July 23.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Europe oil, gas rigs at 61 to July 23.

text.p: The number of active oil and gas rigs operating offshore Northwest Europe totalled 61 in the week ending July 23, consultants Arthur Andersen said.
There were 28 rigs drilling in the UK sector and 17 in the Norwegian sector. Denmark and Ireland had three each while the Netherlands had 10 rigs.

Andersen said in their weekly well report that the level of exploration and appraisal well starts -- including two onshore drills -- for the year so far remained at 63, which is five percent up on 1996.
